name: Orchestration {OS}
tagline: Compose many agents and systems into one reliable mission.

commands.name: /orchestrate shape <mission>
commands.summary: Draw the topology and justify every edge and every barrier.

commands.name: /orchestrate plan <mission>
commands.summary: Write the durable ledger, one entry per ask, persisted to a file.

commands.name: /orchestrate dispatch
commands.summary: Start the ready set concurrently, with owners, budgets and scope claims.

commands.name: /orchestrate watch
commands.summary: Classify each running step as working, stalled, blocked or asking, and act.

commands.name: /orchestrate verify <task>
commands.summary: Run the verification the brief named, recorded apart from the delegate's claim.

commands.name: /orchestrate synthesise
commands.summary: Assemble every child output into one coherent result.

commands.name: /orchestrate close
commands.summary: Signal clean, pending or failed, release claims, and leave nothing running.

commands.name: /orchestrate resume <mission>
commands.summary: Continue an interrupted mission from its persisted ledger.

commands.name: /orchestrate postmortem <mission>
commands.summary: Turn a failure or an overrun into a change to the shape or the ledger.

requires_human_approval_for: dispatching a step that performs an irreversible action with no recorded gate
changing an agent's brief mid mission
closing a mission as clean when any entry lacks independent verification
killing a worker that holds uncommitted work
re-running a step whose external effects are not idempotent
